text_block_list.text:
H-Haaaah~~~!? Ow, that hurts...! What the 
hell, this stuff pops way too hard!!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a hit! The one with popping 
candy! It zaps your tongue, but it's 
totally addictive, right~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Quit messing with me! This is obviously 
just a trap, damn it...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... Dammit...! The inside of my mouth 
is still exploding...
